comment: [SECURITY_CHECKLIST #66] Reviewed exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry date (max ~6 months); expired entries fail CI.

advisories.reason: No patched release exists; npm's suggested fix is a downgrade to @solana/spl-token@0.1.8. The backend only reaches toBigIntLE() on account data from its own RPC reads, never on client-supplied buffers. Re-evaluate when spl-token drops buffer-layout-utils.
